But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? My question is [1] when I am returning to Aziziya on the 7th Zil Haj from Madina when I wear the Ihram at the miqat Zul Hudaifa whether I should make the niyat of Haj of Tamattu only and go to MIna straight away to complete the Haj arkaans or I should again do a Umra and then go to Mina on the 8th of Zil-Haj. When I first came to Mecca from India during Zil Qayida I would have already performed one Umra ss for Haj-e-Tamattu. So is it required to perform another Umra before Haj ? Since I am returing to Aziziya only on the 7th Zil-Haj evening I will also not have sufficient time to to to Mecca to perform the Umra. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 46224 Country: INDIA Title: Hajj-e-Badal Question: May I perform Hajj-e-Badal of my deceased son-in-law? I wish to go for Hajj-e-Badal with my daughter. I have done my Hajj before four years. I also want to know that what is the difference between normal Hajj and Hajj-e-Badal? What procedure one has to do extra in Hajj-e-Badal. Answer ID: 46224 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1087/1087/M=9/1434) There is no addition or changes in the arkan (acts) of Hajj-e-Badal and its method. What you have to do is just say while making the intention that you are doing Hajj-e-Badal from so and so person. After that you should perform all other rituals as you do in normal Hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
